content: Abeṭṭu n tgeldit
Raḥabɛam yuyur ɣar Cakim, maɣar marra Israil yusa-dd ɣar Cakim, ḥima ad t ggen d ajeǧid.
Umi isřa Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ, x man aya, umi tuɣa ɛad di Miṣra - aqa netta tuɣa yarweř zi zzat n wudem n ujeǧid Suliman u Yarubɛam tuɣa izdeɣ di Miṣra - imsar
aqa ssekken-dd ɣares ireqqasen, jjin ad xas řaɣan. Yarubɛam d marra agraw n řgens n Israil usin-dd, ssiwřen ak-d Raḥabɛam, nnan:
“Babac igga xaneɣ ijj n uzayřu iqseḥ. Xenni řexxu, sarxu cek řxedmet iqesḥen n babac uřa d azayřu iḍeqřen i xaneɣ igga, xenni ad cek nexdem.”
Netta inna asen: “Uyurem u ɛeqbem awarni i třata n wussan.” Uca yuyur řgens.
Imcawar ujeǧid Raḥabɛam ak-d imeqqranen, inni tuɣa ibedden zzat i wudem n babas Suliman umi tuɣa ɛad iddar, inna: “S min zi d ayi tweṣṣam ad dd-arreɣ x řgens-a?”

Nitni ssiwřen akides, nnan: “Mařa cek teggid ixef nnec ass-a d amsexxar i řgens-a, ad xasen tsexxared, ad xasen dd-tarred u ad kidsen tessiwřed s wawařen icnan, xenni ad dewřen nitni d imsexxaren nnec i řebda.”
Maca netta inḍar ccwar i d as tuɣa wcin imeqqranen uca imcawar ak-d iḥudriyyen nni tuɣa akides imɣaren u bedden řexxu zzat i wudem nnes.
Netta isseqsa ten: “Man tᵉttcawarem ad t dd-narr x wawař n řgens, minzi ssiwřen akidi, nnan ayi: ‘Sarxu azayřu i xaneɣ igga babac.’”

Iḥudriyyen nni akides tuɣa imɣaren ssiwřen akides, nnan: “Ammu i dd ɣa tarred x řgens i kidek issiwřen, innan: ‘Babac isseḍqeř azayřu nneɣ, maca řexxu cek sarxu t xaneɣ!’ u ammu i kidsen i ɣa tessiwřed: ‘Aḍaḍ ameẓyan inu ad yiři d ameqqran x tejɛinna n baba.
Xenni řexxu, aqa baba iqqen awem ijj n uzayřu iqesḥen, xenni necc ad t ssḍeqřeɣ ɛad. Baba yarebba kenniw s urekkuḍ, necc ad kenniw arebbiɣ s iɣarḍmiwen.’”
Deg wass wiss třata usin-dd Yarubɛam d marra řgens ɣar Raḥabɛam, am mammec tuɣa issiweř ujeǧid, inna: “Ɛeqbem-dd ɣari awarni i třata n wussan!”
Ajeǧid yarra-dd řgens s ict n temwarrit iqesḥen, maɣar netta inḍar ccwar i d as wcin imeqqranen.
Issiweř akidsen ɛlaḥsab ccwar n iḥudriyyen, inna: “Baba isseḍqeř azayřu nwem, maca necc ad ssḍeqřeɣ ɛad azayřu nwem. Baba yarebbi kenniw s urekkuḍ, necc ad kenniw arebbiɣ s iɣarḍmiwen.”
Ajeǧid war isři ca ɣar řgens, maɣar aneqřeb-a tuɣa i dd-yusa zi SIDI, ḥima ad issemten awař i tuɣa issiweř SIDI s ufus n Axiya, Aciluni, i Yarubɛam, mmis n Nabaṭ.

Umi marra Israil iẓra aqa ajeǧid war ɣarsen isři ca, yarra-dd řgens x ujeǧid, nnan: “Man tasɣart i ɣarneɣ di Dawud? Neccin war ɣarneɣ bu tesɣart ɣar mmis n Yassa. Ɣar iqiḍan nnec, a Israil! Řha řexxu ak-d taddart nnec, a ayt n Dawud!” Uca yuyur Israil ɣar iqiḍan nsen.
Maca x ayt n Israil inni tuɣa izeddɣen di tneddam n Yahuda, aqa Raḥabɛam tuɣa xasen d ajeǧid.

Ajeǧid Raḥabɛam issekk ɣarsen Aduram, wenni iǧan x ljizya n tesmuɣi, u marra Israil yarjem i-t s yeẓra ařami immut. Ajeǧid Raḥabɛam iqeǧeb, maḥend ad yenya deɣya x ijj n ukarru ḥima ad yarweř ɣar Urcalim.
Ammu i iɣewweɣ Israil x taddart n Dawud, ař ass-a.

Umi marra Israil isřa aqa Yarubɛam iɛqeb-dd, imsar, aqa ssekken ɣares maḥend ad as dd-řaɣan, ḥima ad dd-yas ɣar tmesmunt uca ggin t d ajeǧid x marra Israil. Uřa d ijj war iqqim iḍeffar ɛad taddart n Dawud mɣir taqbič n Yahuda.

Umi dd-yusa Raḥabɛam ɣar Urcalim, issmun marra taddart n Yahuda d teqbič n Binyamin, mya u-tmenyin-ařef n iryazen ittwafarzen, ttwadarrben i umenɣi, ḥima ad mmenɣen ak-d taddart n Israil, ḥima ad dd-arren tageldit ɣar Raḥubɛam, mmis n Suliman.
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n AREBBI ɣar Camɛiya aryaz n AREBBI, inna:
“Siweř ak-d Raḥabɛam, mmis n Suliman, ajeǧid n Yahuda, u ak-d marra taddart n Yahuda u tenni n Binyamin u i marra min iqqimen n řgens, ini:

‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: War ttgeɛɛdem u war ttmenɣam ak-d aytmatwem, ayt n Israil. Ittxeṣṣa ad iɛqeb kuř ijj n weryaz ɣar taddart nnes, maɣar d man aya i imsaren zzayi.’” Nitni sřin ɣar wawař n SIDI uca ɛeqben uca uyuren ɣar wemcan nsen ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI. *
Yarubɛam ibna Cakim x idurar n Ifrayim uca izdeɣ dinni. Ssenni iffeɣ uca ibna Fanuwil.
Inna Yarubɛam deg wuř nnes: “Řexxu ad dd-teɛqeb tgeldit ɣar taddart n Dawud.

Maɣar mařa řgens-a ad dd-igeɛɛed, ḥima ad yawi tiwhibin di Taddart n SIDI di Urcalim, xenni ad dd-idweř wuř n řgens-a ɣar siditsen, ɣar Raḥabɛam, ajeǧid n Yahuda. Ad ayi nɣen u ad dd-ɛeqben ɣar Raḥabɛam, ajeǧid n Yahuda.”
Imcawar ujeǧid, xenni igga tnayen n iɛejmiyyen n wureɣ, inna asen i řgens: “D aṭṭas i kenniw maḥend ad tgeɛɛdem ɣar Urcalim. Xzar, irebbiten nnec, a Israil, inni cek i dd-issuffɣen zi Miṣra.”
Netta issbedd ijj n ṣṣanam n ufunas di Bayt-Il u wenneɣni issbedd i-t di Dan.
Aya idweř d aɛraḍ ɣar ddnub. Řgens izwar yuyur zzat i wudem n ijj n ufunas ař Dan.
Netta issbedd ict n zzawect x řegɛudi. Igga ikehhanen i dd-iqqarṣen zi marra ṭṭrufa n řgens inni war iǧin zeg ayt n Lawi.

Deg uyur wiss tmenya, deg wass wiss xemmesṭac n uyur, igga Yarubɛam ijj n řɛid, am řɛid i tteggen di Yahuda, u netta issgeɛɛed tiɣarṣa x uɛalṭar. Igga ammu di Bayt-Il ḥima ad iqeddem tiɣarṣa i iɛejmiyyem i yegga. Igga ɛawed ikehhanen di Bit-Il x řegɛudi nni igga.

Deg wass wiss xemmesṭac deg uyur wiss tmenya n uyur i tuɣa ixarreṣ netta deg wuř nnes, issgeɛɛed tiɣarṣa x uɛalṭar nni igga di Bayt-Il. Ammu i issbedd ijj n řɛid i ayt n Israil uca issbexxar řebxur x uɛalṭar.
